I stopped before doing anything else, as you asked. The walkthrough tool isn't available in this session, so I couldn't connect to your Chrome session.

Only 7 of the website tools became usable, and the walkthrough recorder wasn't one of them. I can use the tool that checks a walkthrough script, but not the one that runs it. The session also reports that the project is in **Clean room** mode.

I haven't tried the endpoint at `http://127.0.0.1:9222`, because the only tool that could have reached it is the one that's missing. I didn't use the site-open or site-capture tools, I didn't touch the login page, and I didn't build anything.

**Why it's probably missing:** Clean room mode only offers tools that look at a site from the outside. Driving your own signed-in browser through a series of clicks likely counts as "inside" access, so the tool is hidden until Deep mode is on. That's my best guess, not something the tool told me.

**What you can do:**

2. **Or keep Clean room on** and send me screenshots of the dashboard and its menus. I can rebuild the dashboard from those instead of from a live walkthrough.
